name: TradingAgents
description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
one_liner: A free toolkit where several specialized AI 'analysts' (fundamentals, news, sentiment, risk) debate and vote on a trade, like a miniature research desk you run yourself.
buyer: A self-directed retail trader or small quant-curious investor who wants a disciplined, multi-angle research process instead of trading on gut feeling, and is willing to pay for a polished version of this workflow.
business_use_cases: A retail trader runs it against their own watchlist each morning as a structured 'second opinion' before placing trades, instead of guessing.
A small fintech content creator builds a paid newsletter or Discord where they publish daily TradingAgents-generated research debates with their own commentary.
A boutique quant shop uses it as a rapid prototyping layer to test new trading-strategy ideas before committing engineering time to a full backtest system.

money_ideas.idea: Package a hosted, easier-to-use version with a clean dashboard and charge retail traders a monthly fee for daily multi-agent trade research.
Sell curated 'AI trading desk' reports built on top of it to a paid newsletter audience.

steal_this: Run it against five stocks you already follow this weekend and publish the AI debate transcripts as free content to build an audience for a future paid tool.
